content.text: In Zimbabwe, where financial isolation is a harsh reality, digital creators can't rely on Stripe and other conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-stack-started-generating|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-2|USDT Payment]] platforms. Instead, they're forced to build workarounds or rely on sketchy intermediaries that take a massive cut of their earnings. But there's a better way. By leveraging the power of Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments, you can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that's fully autonomous, fully secure, and fully yours. No more dependence on platforms that can freeze your funds or shut down your shop at a moment's notice. With this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-2|architecture]], you're in control, and that's the real secret to success in digital commerce.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

When a customer buys a digital product from your shop, you want the order to be fulfilled automatically, without any human intervention. This means sending the customer a download link or triggering a delivery process that's triggered by a crypto payment confirmation. But how do you make this happen, especially when you're not relying on Stripe or other conventional payment platforms? The answer lies in a sovereign digital commerce stack built with Google Apps Script, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This architecture allows you to process orders in under 30 seconds, without any manual intervention, and with a 99.99% uptime guarantee.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this architecture is Google Apps Script, which acts as the backend logic engine for your shop. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook sends a notification to the Cloudflare Workers, which then triggers the Google Apps Script to send a delivery email to the customer. Meanwhile, the Supabase or Google Sheets database stores the order details, ensuring that everything is tracked and recorded accurately. This setup allows you to automate the entire delivery process, from payment confirmation to order fulfillment, in a fraction of the time it would take with manual intervention.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products in countries where Stripe and other conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. Whether you're in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or any other country facing financial isolation, this architecture gives you the freedom to build a fully autonomous digital shop that's resistant to platform shutdowns and financial restrictions.
With this architecture, you can process orders in under 30 seconds, without any manual intervention.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make up this architecture are carefully chosen to work together seamlessly. Google Apps Script provides the backend logic engine, Cloudflare Workers handles the webhook events, and NOWPayments takes care of the crypto payment verification. Meanwhile, Supabase or Google Sheets provides the database storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 handles the file delivery. This setup ensures that every aspect of the delivery process is automated, efficient, and secure.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture today, start by signing up for the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which includes everything you need to get started, including Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Next, configure the Google Apps Script to trigger the delivery email, and set up the Supabase or Google Sheets database to store the order details. Finally, test the entire setup to ensure that everything is working seamlessly, and you're ready to launch your fully autonomous digital shop.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The most important question you'll ask is: Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms? The answer is yes, and it's made possible by the NOWPayments webhook pipeline, which triggers the Google Apps Script to send a delivery email to the customer. This setup allows you to automate the entire delivery process, from payment confirmation to order fulfillment, in a fraction of the time it would take with manual intervention.
The NOWPayments webhook pipeline is the key to automating digital product delivery with crypto payments.

Your Deployment Checklist

Deploy your backend first — Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible via HTTP POST before configuring NOWPayments. Set the IPN webhook URL in your NOWPayments account settings to point to your backend endpoint. Set the IPN secret key in both NOWPayments and your backend configuration — this is the string that both sides use to verify webhook authenticity. Upload your product files to the configured delivery storage — Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive — with the paths matching your backend configuration. Complete a real mainnet transaction and check your backend logs to confirm the webhook was received, the signature was validated, the transaction was verified on-chain, the order was logged, and the delivery email was sent. Monitor the order database daily for the first week.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works with crypto payments by leveraging the NOWPayments webhook pipeline, which triggers the Google Apps Script to send a delivery email to the customer. This setup allows you to automate the entire delivery process, from payment confirmation to order fulfillment, in a fraction of the time it would take with manual intervention.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a notification sent by the NOWPayments system to the Cloudflare Workers, which then triggers the Google Apps Script to send a delivery email to the customer. Webhooks are a crucial component of automated digital product delivery, allowing you to automate the entire delivery process without any manual intervention.
Can I use this architecture with other payment gateways?

While this architecture is specifically designed to work with NOWPayments, you can adapt it to work with other payment gateways by modifying the Google Apps Script and Cloudflare Workers to accommodate the new payment gateway's webhook notifications.
How do I configure the Google Apps Script to trigger the delivery email?

Configuring the Google Apps Script to trigger the delivery email involves setting up a trigger to run the script when a payment is received, and then modifying the script to send a delivery email to the customer. This process requires some technical expertise, but is well within the reach of most developers.
What happens if the customer's email bounces or is invalid?

If the customer's email bounces or is invalid, the Google Apps Script will automatically retry delivering the email, and if that fails, it will store the order details in the Supabase or Google Sheets database for later reference.
